name: smart-librarian-ai-rag
description: Smart Librarian is a full-stack book recommendation application. A user describes what they want to read in the React interface, and the FastAPI backend combines input filtering, semantic retrieval from a Chroma catalogue, and an OpenAI recommendation workflow to return one book, its rationale, and the complete locally stored summary.

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.dev:servers: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
